div.div:
/rfe-auto-fix
--type {t}, --jql "{query}"
--limit N, --batch-size N (default 50)
--data-dir {path}, --random N
--headless, --announce-complete
--reprocess
trailing args = explicit IDs

div.div:

[--headless] {IDs}
forwards ONLY --type / --headless / IDs
never --jql, --data-dir, --limit,
--batch-size, --reprocess, --random
prints TYPE RESOLVED: {type} ({how})
launch-vars {type} auto-fix

div.div:
PHASES (31) - scripts/pipeline_state.py
noop / script (run_script) / agent (launch_wave)
BATCH_START FETCH SETUP
ASSESS REVIEW REVISE FIXUP
REASSESS_CHECK REASSESS_SAVE
REASSESS_ASSESS REASSESS_REVIEW
REASSESS_RESTORE REASSESS_REVISE
REASSESS_FIXUP
COLLECT SPLIT SPLIT_COLLECT
SPLIT_PIPELINE_START SPLIT_ASSESS
SPLIT_REVIEW SPLIT_REVISE SPLIT_FIXUP
SPLIT_SAVE SPLIT_REASSESS
SPLIT_RE_REVIEW SPLIT_RESTORE
SPLIT_CORRECTION_CHECK
BATCH_DONE ERROR_COLLECT REPORT DONE
BATCH_DONE -> BATCH_START while batch < total
ERROR_COLLECT -> BATCH_START (1 retry batch)

next-action YAML - the launch_wave contract
action: launch_wave
phase: ASSESS
message: "ASSESS: wave 1/2 (5 IDs)"
agents:
- subagent_type: rfe-scorer
prompt_file: .claude/skills/rfe-review/
prompts/assess-agent.md
vars: |
KEY=RHAIRFE-1234
DATA_FILE=tmp/rfe-assess/single/
RHAIRFE-1234.md
RUN_DIR=tmp/rfe-assess/single
PROMPT_PATH=.context/assess-rfe/.../
agent_prompt.md
- prompt_file: types/rfe/dimensions/
feasibility.md
vars: |
ID=RHAIRFE-1234

div.div:
Step 4b - Batch
split process IDs into batch_size chunks
state.py write-ids
tmp/pipeline-batch-{N}-ids.txt
pipeline_state.py set total_batches={M}
pipeline_state.py set-phase BATCH_START
idle run: no batch files, total_batches=0

div.div:
Dispatch loop - repeat until phase DONE
Run it to completion: never stop early, skip a batch or summarize before every batch is processed.
Budget and timeout are managed externally - ignore any "running low on context" impulse.
Bash discipline: exactly one operation per Bash call; no $(...) substitution and no ; && || chaining
(they prompt for approval and are denied headless). Values move between commands through tmp/ files written with state.py.
